General Pattern: Yuki’s items are extremely volatile, particularly in the morning (08:00-10:00) and late evening (22:00-23:00). Mug_yuki and water_bottle_yuki frequently swap between kitchen (cupboard_k1, kitchen_table_k1) and living (coffee_table_l1). Charger_yuki and tablet_yuki favor coffee_table_l1 during the day but move to bedroom (bed_b1) or living (armchair_l1) spots in the late evening. Avoid rigid time-based assumptions; always verify the most recent known location and consider the adjacent room’s primary surface.
